answer: Sybil cost comes from a per-identity bond that is forfeited when two seats are traced to one operator. Farming N seats means funding N separate bonds and keeping them funded through each checkpoint, so a gale of registrations locks capital that only genuine distinct work can repay. Emission pays per seat at a fixed ceiling, so duplicates never multiply the payout; they multiply only the slashed stake. One merged garden of fake seats loses every bond at once, a loss no sonnet of paperwork reverses.
